headline: Quiet Saturday as earlier stories fade
body: Nothing new was scored today. A few endings shifted by a hundredth of a point as earlier announcements faded, and Horizon Balance sits at -4.20. The ranking is unchanged: Enslaved God leads at 41.73, with Conquerors second at 27.29 and Benevolent Dictator third.
movers_note: No ending moved by a tenth of a point; only fading earlier events, at 0.01 each.
